title: Claude Code talk
description: One exam-style question about planning a large change.

polls.question: Your team must split one large app into many smaller services. Many files will change. You must decide where each service starts and stops. What do you do first?

options.label: Start to change the code. Learn the structure as you go.
Use plan mode. Explore the code and design the change first.
Write very detailed instructions. Then run them directly.
Start directly. Change to plan mode only if problems occur.
